description: มุน 2026-07-31 (ดวงสมพงศ์ ก้อน 2G "ดูดวงสมพงศ์ล่าสุด"). Safety-net for 2F: once the calc wait is visible, a user who bails has spent quota but has no result — 2G is the reachable history list that re-opens the already-computed result. Bug-class run-compat-2g owns (visual/presentation + state-table): (a) D40 RULE-4 — a card must NOT fabricate a friend name (v1 falls back to the literal "เพื่อน" → "คุณ & เพื่อน"); absent name → "คุณ", absent avatar → an initial-letter placeholder (not a fake photo). (b) D43 — a legacy matching_type v2 dropped (BOSS/EMPLOYEE) must HIDE the chip, keep the card clickable, and NOT crash the screen. (c) D39 state-table — no infinite spinner: list→cards, empty→"ยังไม่มีประวัติ", error(non-array/{error})→honest fallback, no-userId→resolved-empty. (d) D41 — a card opens the ALREADY-computed result via router.push(/result/<id>), NO re-calculate (v1 onSelectLog re-calculates = a second quota hit; 2G does not). (e) D42 — deep-link from history has no sessionStorage carry → the shared result header hides the birthdate line quietly (no fabricated date, no crash). run-compat-2g.ts proves (browser @393, UserMatchingGetApi + get-detail route-mocked, no BE): 4 mixed rows render incl. legacy BOSS (no crash), LOVE→"คู่รัก" / FRIEND→"เพื่อนร่วมงาน" chips, BOSS chip hidden, "คุณ & ก้อง" / absent-name→"คุณ", D41 nav to /result/R-LOVE, D42 birth line hidden, empty/error/no-userId states resolve, console 0. Instrument catch: the anchor surfaced a real HYDRATION mismatch — useState(!!userId) read the cookie differently SSR vs client → the dev error overlay (<nextjs-portal>) intercepted every click; fixed by starting loading=true unconditionally (effect resolves no-userId), matching useCompatibility. Tooth: mut-fake-friend-name (recentCardTitle returns "คุณ & เพื่อน" when name absent → the rule-4 checks trip → CAUGHT; negative-control: baseline clean, mutant trips only rule-4). D38 wiring = a 1-line onClick change in the shipped CompatibilityScreen.tsx (kept minimal; 2F edits the same file, merge order 2F→2G with a rebase not a hand-resolve — บอง-locked). NO pages/matching or api-user-matching edited. gate_layer=visual/recent-list+D40-rule4-no-fake+D43-legacy-no-crash+D39-state-table+D41-no-recalc.
